A small town in the far north goes about its life: preparing for the Festival of the New Star, decorating streets, celebrating. The festival is inseparable from a cycle that repeats month after month. And Sonya stands at its center. She's part of a story she's still trying to understand. A kind girl with a sharp mind and countless questions, she searches for answers among snow and lights.
